detail.purpose: team-level round aggregates, fast queries without player-level joins.
detail.use_cases: team-level round aggregates, fast queries without player-level joins.
detail.example_sql:
SELECT
    team_name,
    COUNT(*) AS rounds,
    SUM(round_won) AS wins,
    ROUND(SUM(round_won) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS win_rate,
    ROUND(AVG(team_adr), 1) AS avg_adr
FROM agg_team_round_summary
GROUP BY team_name
ORDER BY win_rate DESC;

detail.purpose: player impact quantification using probability lift weights.
detail.use_cases: player impact quantification using probability lift weights.
detail.example_sql:
SELECT
    player_name,
    team_name,
    SUM(rounds_played) AS total_rounds,
    ROUND(AVG(win_share_per_round), 3) AS avg_ws_per_round,
    ROUND(AVG(survival_rate), 3) AS avg_survival
FROM agg_player_win_shares
GROUP BY player_name, team_name
HAVING SUM(rounds_played) > 200
ORDER BY avg_ws_per_round DESC
LIMIT 10;
